crew.overview: A widowed farmer and his son warily take in a mysterious, injured man with a satchel of cash. When a posse of men claiming to be the law come for the money, the farmer must decide who to trust. Defending a siege of his homestead, the farmer reveals a talent for gun-slinging that surprises everyone calling his true identity into question.
crew.title: Old Henry

details.biography: Potsy Ponciroli is a director and writer, known for Old Henry (2021), Jay and Silent Bob Reboot (2019) and Ted K (2021).  He has been married to Amber Ponciroli since October 19, 2018.  He has two children.  He is originally from Virginia but moved to Nashville after college.  Before he got into movies he worked in music videos and filming those.
details.name: Potsy Ponciroli
